ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two slanted lines j and k, which have the same arrow markings, indicating j ∥ k. Another slanted line ℓ passes through these two parallel lines from the lower left to the upper right, forming a transversal. Near the left intersection are labeled angles 1, 2, 3, 4, among which ∠3 is located between the two parallel lines and above transversal ℓ. Near the right intersection are labeled angles 5, 6, 7, 8, among which ∠5 is also located between the two parallel lines and above transversal ℓ. Reasoning: Because j ∥ k, and ℓ is a transversal, ∠3 and ∠5 are same-side interior angles, so they are supplementary: m∠3 + m∠5 = 180. It is known that m∠5 = 68, m∠3 = 3y - 2, therefore (3y - 2) + 68 = 180. Simplifying gives 3y + 66 = 180, 3y = 114, so y = 38.
